title: Commissioner General of Motor Traffic arrested by CID
byline: The Commissioner General of Motor Traffic, Kamal Amarasinghe, has been arrested by the Criminal Investigations Department (CID).

title: Twelve US troops wounded in Iran strike on base in Saudi Arabia
byline: Twelve US troops were wounded, two of them seriously, in an Iranian military strike on Prince Sultan Air Base in Saudi Arabia, a ⁠U.S. official told Reuters on Friday.

title: Showers expected in several districts today
byline: Showers or thundershowers may occur at a few places in the Ratnapura, Kalutara, Galle, and Matara districts during the evening or night today (28), the Department of Meteorology stated.

title: US hopes for Iran meetings ‘this week’: envoy Witkoff
byline: US special envoy Steve Witkoff said Friday he believes Iran will hold talks with Washington “this week,” as President Donald Trump reiterated his claims that Tehran wants to make a deal.

title: Trump says ‘Cuba is next’ in speech touting US military successes
byline: US President Donald Trump on Friday said “Cuba is next” during a speech at an investment forum in Miami during which he touted the successes of U.S. military action in Venezuela and Iran.

title: Rubio says Iran war to last ‘weeks not months,’ no US ground troops needed
byline: The U.S. expects its military operations against Iran to conclude within weeks, not months, and Washington can meet all its objectives without using ground troops, U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio said on Friday.

title: Russia to introduce ban on gasoline exports from April 1, govt says
byline: Russian Deputy Prime Minister Alexander Novak on Friday instructed the energy ministry to draft a resolution banning gasoline exports from April 1, the Russian government said.

title: Online scam racket busted in Negombo; 18 foreign nationals arrested
byline: A total of 18 foreign nationals, including 16 Chinese nationals and two Cambodian nationals, have been arrested in Negombo for allegedly operating an online financial scam racket while in Sri Lanka.

title: More details on arrest of Commissioner General of Motor Traffic
byline: The Commissioner General of Motor Traffic, Kamal Amarasinghe, was arrested by the Criminal Investigation Department (CID) last night (27).

title: Austria becomes latest to propose social media ban for children
byline: Austria has announced plans to ban social media for children aged under 14, becoming the latest country to consider introducing restrictions for children online.

title: Nepal’s ex-PM Oli held over deaths during Gen Z protests
byline: Nepal’s former prime minister, K.P. Sharma Oli, was taken into custody on Saturday as police investigate whether he was negligent in failing to prevent dozens of deaths during Gen Z protests last September.

title: Israel faces incoming missile from Yemen, first such launch of war
byline: Israel’s military said that Yemen had launched a missile toward Israel, the first time it had faced fire from that country.

title: PS5 price hiked in UK and US due to global ‘pressures’
byline: Sony is raising the price of the PlayStation 5 by £90 in the UK and by $100 in the US, in a dramatic hike it says is due to “continued pressures in the global economic landscape”.

title: Police officer killed in hit-and-run by tractor illegally transporting sand in Jaffna
byline: A Police Sergeant was killed after being run over by a tractor that was illegally transporting sand in the Kodikamam area of Jaffna.

title: Married couple dies in traffic collision in Mahiyanganaya
byline: A married couple has died in a road accident that occurred in the 3rd Mile Post area on the Mahiyanganaya–Girandurukotte Road, police said.

title: SLAAP assures consistent chicken supply ahead of festive season
byline: The Sri Lanka Association of Animal Production (SLAAP) says steps have been taken to ensure an uninterrupted supply of chicken to the market during the upcoming festive season.

title: Special traffic and security operation to begin April 1 for Sinhala and Tamil New Year
byline: Deputy Inspector General (DIG) of Traffic Control and Road Safety, W. P. J. Senadheera, has announced that a special security operation will be launched starting on April 1, in view of the upcoming festive season.

title: Heat index at ‘caution level’ across multiple provinces today – Met. Dept
byline: The Department of Meteorology of Sri Lanka says that the temperature felt on the human body may remain at a ‘Caution Level’ in several areas of the island today (28).

title: Man arrested for hoarding 1,235 liters of diesel in Warakapola
byline: An individual has been arrested in the Mahena area of Warakapola for allegedly hoarding 1,235 liters of diesel without a valid license, police said.

title: Sri Lanka among most vulnerable nations in event of Strait of Hormuz shutdown, study warns
byline: Sri Lanka has been identified as one of the world’s most vulnerable nations to a sudden shutdown of the Strait of Hormuz, according to a March 2026 report by the Kiel Institute for the World Economy.

title: Increase in road accidents observed so far this year: Sri Lanka Police
byline: Sri Lanka Police says that an increase in road accidents has been observed during the past few months of this year compared to the same period last year.

title: PM Harini highlights govt’s commitment to technological education for children
byline: The Prime Minister, Dr. Harini Amarasuriya, stated that it is the government’s objective to establish an education system that ensures every child has access to modern technological opportunities.

title: Houthis confirm they launched attack against Israel
byline: The Iranian backed Houthis in Yemen have confirmed they have attacked Israel for the first time since the start of the US-Israeli war with Iran.

title: No fuel price revision on March 31 - CPC Chairman
byline: The Chairman of the Ceylon Petroleum Corporation (CPC), D.J. Rajakaruna has announced that there will be no revision in fuel prices on March 31, 2026.

title: Five CPC officials appointed to address fuel-related issues in ministries
byline: It was decided at the committee appointed to oversee the distribution of essential goods to appoint five officials from the Ceylon Petroleum Corporation to cover all ministries in order to examine fuel-related issues and undertake the necessary interventions.

title: Woman arrested for possession of various narcotics in Panchikawatte
byline: A woman has been arrested in the Panchikawatte area for possession of narcotics, police said.

title: Trump calls Strait of Hormuz the ‘Strait of Trump’
byline: President Donald Trump on Friday winkingly referred to the Strait of Hormuz, the vital oil-shipping route and a key choke point in the Iran war, as the “Strait of Trump.”

title: Iran’s president says trust needed for talks, Pakistan prime minister’s office says
byline: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian has told Pakistan’s Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif that trust is needed to facilitate talks and mediation on the conflict in ⁠the Middle East, the prime minister’s office said on Saturday.

title: China’s top legislator meets Sri Lankan parliament speaker
byline: China’s top legislator Zhao Leji met with Sri Lankan Parliament Speaker Jagath Wickramaratne, who was in Boao, south China’s Hainan Province, to attend the Boao Forum for Asia Annual Conference 2026.

title: Water cut in Dehiwala, Mt. Lavinia, Ratmalana, Moratuwa & other areas
byline: The National Water Supply and Drainage Board (NWSDB) announced that a five-hour water cut will be imposed in several areas, including Kalubowila, Dehiwala, Mount Lavinia, Ratmalana and Moratuwa from 9.00 a.m. to 2.00 p.m. tomorrow (29).

title: Pakistan to host talks with Saudi Arabia, Turkey, Egypt amid Iran war diplomacy
byline: Pakistan will host Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Egypt for talks from Sunday on the Iran war as Islamabad positions itself as a potential venue for U.S.-Iran negotiations on the month-old conflict.

title: Commissioner General of Motor Traffic remanded
byline: The Commissioner General of Motor Traffic, Kamal Amarasinghe, who was arrested by the Criminal Investigation Department (CID), has been remanded until Monday (March 30) by the Pilessa Magistrate’s Court in Kurunegala.

title: Japan signs grant to provide eight low-floor buses for public transportation in Sri Lanka
byline: Ambassador of Japan to Sri Lanka, Akio Isomata and Secretary of Transport, Highways and Urban Development, Senior Professor K. Kapila C. K. Perera signed a grant contract for a project, under the scheme of “Grant Assistance for Grassroots Human Security Projects (GGP),” to provide eight (8) large low-floor buses for public transportation.

title: TV Derana picks up top awards at Raigam Tele’es 2025
byline: The Raigam Tele’es Award Ceremony 2025, recognising and celebrating the most outstanding tele-creations telecast during the calendar year 2025, is currently underway at the Shangri-La Hotel, Colombo.

title: Russia’s Deputy Foreign Minister to visit Sri Lanka
byline: The Deputy Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Russian Federation, Andrey Rudenko, is scheduled to visit Sri Lanka on Tuesday (March 31) for an official visit.

title: Police seek public assistance to arrest foreign national wanted for murder
byline: The Mount Lavinia Divisional Crime Investigation Bureau has launched an investigation into the murder of a female Chinese national residing at a housing complex, within the Kohuwala Police Division on 23 March 2026.

title: Raigam Tele’es 2025: Ada Derana wins Most Popular News Provider
byline: The Raigam Tele’es Award Ceremony 2025, recognising and celebrating the most outstanding tele-creations telecast during the calendar year 2025, is currently underway at the Shangri-La Hotel, Colombo.
